reader.requirement: At --std 85 the GROUP INDICATE clause of a report group description entry is the key word GROUP followed by the optional word INDICATE (INDICATE is not underlined), so both GROUP INDICATE and GROUP alone must be accepted, and any other arrangement (INDICATE alone, GROUP IS INDICATE, a repeated word or clause) refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 screens the entry against §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR11 Table 1 (GROUP INDICATE counts as a format-3 clause), and the 2002 COLUMN / SOURCE-or-VALUE placement faults are asked only at >= 2002; the detail-group fault at every edition
year >= 2002: a GROUP INDICATE item counts as a PRESENT WHEN clause for the column-overlap rules; at 85 it counts as none (§1985:XIII.3.11.3 SR2)
from 2002 a GENERATE whose group SUPPRESS PRINTING inhibited uses up the occasion; at 85 only a presented group does (GR1 runtime, not the format)
GROUP and INDICATE reserved at every edition

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the format (GROUP [INDICATE] at every edition); the placement rules and the GR1 consumption differ, each with its own 1985 arm, which belong to other rows
